style.evidence: The candidate is a single 16x16 grass tile repeated identically in a 4x3 grid with only 4 shades of green, large flat mid-green background areas, and an obvious repetitive diagonal pattern (including a vertical 2x6 block on the left of each tile). Compared to the Beodeul reference grass, which uses varied tile patterns, subtler dithered base variation, and richer tuft clusters, this looks mechanical and flat.
